video.title: IBM acquires HashiCorp for $6.4 Billion. What should you know!👀 #devops #hashicorp

transcript.text: IBM has officially acquired hash cob for
$6.4 billion and if you are a devops
engineer there are few things that you
need to know with this purchase now IBM
owns all Hashi cop tools including
terraform console Vault and Nomad making
IBM a stronger player in the multicloud
and the hybrid space IBM already owns
Red Hat anible and now with terraform
they have two most popular IC tools in
the market which will help them compete
better with the competitors like AWS
Azure or gcp but what about hashiko with
IBM's Global presence hashiko aims to
expand to more countries right now 75%
of Hashi cop's Revenue come from only us
which might change in the future the
only concern I have with this news as a
devops engineer is will IBM keep
terraform and other Hashi cob tools
still open source or will it make it
more focused on the Enterprise version
what do you think let me know in the
comment section
